subject: BonfyreLedger valuation heuristics must not become canonical financial truth

body.text: Concrete category boundary from the named native estate: cmd/BonfyreLedger/src/main.c currently contains hard-coded replacement-value assumptions such as COST_PER_OPERATOR=0.50, COST_PER_REALIZATION=0.10, reuse/brand multipliers, and emits replacement_cost_usd / portfolio_value_usd. Preserve BonfyreLedger as a first-class named Power, but do not let those heuristics silently become FinancialMetabolism price, billed cost, FinancialEvent, or canonical money fact. Converge the Power through the semantic Shell -> Operator ABI -> Fabric path while classifying its artifact valuation as an explicitly versioned/evidenced estimate or scenario projection. Required proof: changing a BonfyreLedger heuristic assumption changes only that valuation projection; a provider-price update changes the relevant EconomicMeasure without rewriting artifact semantic identity; neither path can manufacture billed cost. If BonfyreLedger already delegates a canonical ledger subcommand, preserve that owner boundary and make the old estimate mode declare its assumptions.
